categories_thin: Independent hotels/motels: only chain extended-stay properties are clearly current in Sayreville; one older independent motel listing (Circle Motor Lodge) is unverified.
Tutoring and test prep: the Parlin/Sayreville market is dominated by franchise learning centres (Kumon, JEI, Tutor Doctor, Mathnasium), which are excluded, leaving no clearly independent centres.
Art schools and pottery studios: none located inside Sayreville or Parlin; nearest are Spotswood, East Brunswick and Metuchen.
Jewelry, bikes, music and framing: only one or two shops each remain in the zone, matching the small downtown retail base.
Photography: mostly single-operator businesses without a published studio address, so only one Parlin-based studio is included.
caveats: Yellow Pages, Cylex, LocalSolution, Manta and BBB pages block direct loads (403/Cloudflare) from this environment, so several entries rest on search-result snippets naming those listings rather than on an opened directory page.
Parlin 08859 straddles Sayreville and Old Bridge Township; Parlin addresses are included per the brief even where the municipal boundary is uncertain.

Bulk-directory entries (us-business.info Yellow Pages data, NJ Business Directory) are often stale and skew toward home-based or defunct firms; these are flagged in active_evidence as single-directory or bulk and should be verified first.
Home-based businesses with residential street addresses were deliberately excluded for privacy, so some micro-businesses in photography, tutoring and trades-adjacent services are missing.

Chains and franchises found and excluded: Lightbridge Academy, The Learning Experience, Goddard School, Kumon, JEI, Mathnasium, Tutor Doctor, Mattress Firm, Petco, Sally Beauty, Extended Stay America, Extra Space Storage, CubeSmart, The UPS Store, Numotion, Starland Ballroom (AEG), CMC Steel and Sabert (large plants).
Group C trades and group A professional listings that appeared in the same directories were skipped because this task covers group D only.
data_gaps: Overpass/OpenStreetMap API requests timed out; no systematic OSM sweep of shops and amenities in the borough was possible.

The Sayreville borough website has no machine-readable business directory or licensed-business list; its Main Street revitalization PDF cites 36 occupied business locations but does not enumerate them.
No Sayreville/Parlin chamber of commerce or downtown BID member directory is published online; the Middlesex County regional chamber directory was not reachable.
Google Maps in this browser returned only a limited four-result view per query, so map-based enumeration was shallow.
BBB, Manta and Yellow Pages category pages could not be opened directly, limiting verification of many single-directory entries.
The bulk Yellow Pages-derived directory was only readable for names starting A-F, so G-Z bulk listings for Sayreville were not swept.
